speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing left chest pain, a productive cough with purulent sputum, and shortness of breath; to begin my assessment, how long have these symptoms been present, and did they start suddenly or gradually?

speaker: Patient
text: 30-year-old male. The patient reports experiencing left-sided chest pain and a productive cough with purulent sputum for the past week. He mentions shortness of breath. States he was diagnosed with influenza recently but did not adhere to the treatment plan provided.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia. Given the one-week duration of productive cough with purulent sputum, shortness of breath, left chest pain, and history of untreated influenza, this presentation is highly suggestive of bacterial pneumonia complicating a viral infection. I recommend immediate diagnostic confirmation. REQUEST TEST: CBC, CRP, and Chest_X-Ray.
